summary: Headless no longer polls: a process-wide HostWake generation (Mutex+Condvar) is bumped after every stdin line, provider/agent event push, runtime event emit (runtime::set_event_hook), approval request and input-queue reply; the main loop records the generation before draining and sleeps until it moves (max 1 s for the owner heartbeat/signal checks). The runtime worker blocks on its command channel and job threads wake it with Command::JobDone (try_send); a host_gone flag set in Drop replaces channel disconnection for shutdown. A failed job-thread spawn is a typed SubmitError::SpawnFailed (runtime_spawn_failed) instead of Closed, and the queue keeps draining.
commands_run: cargo test --locked --all-features --test runtime --test remote_concurrency --test headless_* --test remote_headless* --test cli_session --test stage1_input_queue --test stage1_input_host --test approval_owner --test stage1_tool_batch --test core_session --test tui_task

validation_result.idle_ab: 20 idle headless processes over 10 s: old 104.5 csw/s per process and 0.20 core total; new 1.5 csw/s and ~0 CPU (target <=5 wakeups/s)
validation_result.suites: runtime 12, headless_* (83), remote_headless* 13, input queue/host, approval_owner, tool_batch, core_session 41, tui_task all green

notes: Not yet covered: provider-wait CPU (the transport still parks every 5 ms until ZE-301), a paused-stdout cancel latency test, and an injected spawn-failure test; SIGTERM is now noticed within the 1 s idle wait.
